fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: The publisher’s February 2020 launch article https://blog.blueorangegames.com/blue-orange-celebrates-20-years-with-20-new-games/ displays this photograph of the original English retail display packaging. Its title and components match the cited 2020 English rules. The game was sold in a display tray rather than a conventional box. Reduced to 355 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently danced salsa, or any other Latin dance, starts as the Maraca Player.
clarifications: The Maraca Player then hands the maraca to the player on their left, who becomes the next Maraca Player.
internalEvidence: Rendered PDF page 2 gives the Latin-dance criterion. PDF page 1 says the player to the left of the previous Maraca Player takes the next round. The sheet credits Blue Orange ©2020; maraca and Victory Point tokens match inventory BGG 300096. SHA-256: c69fed9136c4363d799eb6a85a5c81ed050164bef04973e5728a93bf67733a11.
